standard_prerequisites.name: One constructible cohomology sheaf is generated by finitely many affine extensions by zero
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma producing a finite direct sum of j_{U!} of the constant sheaf with U affine mapping onto a given constructible sheaf of Lambda-modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies, at each stage of the induction, the bounded-above piece F^a together with the map to the complex inducing the required isomorphism and surjection on cohomology.

standard_prerequisites.name: The octahedral axiom TR4 of triangulated categories
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Derived Categories, the axiom TR4 for triangulated categories
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the compatibility of the shift-and-compose construction that turns the maps F^{a-1}[-a+1] -> L and L -> F^bullet into a map of complexes F^{a-1} -> ... -> F^b over K.

core_obligations: Dispose of the easy implications (proof lines 13658-13659): (2) implies (3) because the constant sheaf on an affine object is constructible and flat and a finite direct sum of such is again flat and constructible, and (3) implies (1) because a bounded above complex of flat constructible sheaves has constructible cohomology sheaves.

Set up the induction (proof lines 13660-13670): assume K is in D_c^-(X_etale, Lambda) with H^i(K) = 0 for i > b; for every a one constructs a complex F^a -> ... -> F^b whose terms are finite direct sums of j_{U!}Lambda with U affine and a map F^bullet -> K inducing an isomorphism on H^i for i > a and a surjection on H^a.
Base case a = b (proof lines 13671-13672): the cited lemma produces the degree-b term mapping onto H^b(K).

Induction step (proof lines 13673-13684): complete the map to a distinguished triangle F^bullet -> K -> L -> F^bullet[1]; since H^i(L) = 0 for i >= a one applies the cited lemma again to get F^{a-1}[-a+1] -> L, the composite with L -> F^bullet corresponds to a map F^{a-1} -> F^a whose composite with F^a -> F^{a+1} vanishes, and TR4 assembles the map of complexes (F^{a-1} -> ... -> F^b) -> K, closing the induction.
proof_roadmap: Note that (2) => (3) => (1) is immediate from constructibility and flatness of the constant sheaf on an affine object.
Assume constructibility of the cohomology sheaves and build the representing complex by downward induction on the degree, starting at the top nonzero degree.
In the induction step use the octahedral axiom to glue the newly found term to the previously constructed complex.
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes, for a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme X and a Noetherian ring Lambda, the objects K in D^-(X_etale, Lambda) belonging to the subcategory D_c of constructible complexes: equivalently K is represented by a bounded above complex of finite direct sums of j_{U!}Lambda for affine U, and equivalently by a bounded above complex of flat constructible sheaves (statement lines 13643-13656). The proof (proof lines 13658-13685) gives the two easy implications and then a downward induction on the degree a, in which each step completes a map into a distinguished triangle and applies the octahedral axiom. H2: one induction with a nontrivial triangulated gluing step, written out in full.
